science_spec: the Grad-Shafranov equilibrium for the magnetically confined plasma in a tokamak for nuclear fusion: the axisymmetric ideal-MHD force balance for the poloidal magnetic flux psi(R,Z) on a poloidal (R,Z) cross-section, Delta^* psi = -mu0 R^2 dp/dpsi - F dF/dpsi, with p(psi) the plasma pressure and F(psi)=R B_phi the poloidal current function, and a Dirichlet boundary psi=psi_b
codegen_spec: solves the tokamak Grad-Shafranov equilibrium equation for the poloidal flux psi(R,Z) on a 2D structured rectangular domain in the (R,Z) poloidal plane. Use a PETSc DMDA structured grid with a standard 5-point finite-difference discretization of the Grad-Shafranov operator Delta^* psi = d2psi/dR2 - (1/R) dpsi/dR + d2psi/dZ2, and solve the resulting system with SNES (a nonlinear solver; the residual is linear here so it converges in one Newton step). Use the Solov'ev choice of profiles in which the right-hand side is -(C0 + C1*R^2) with C0 and C1 constants, so the equation is Delta^* psi = C0 + C1*R^2. VERIFY the solver with the method of manufactured solutions: pick the exact solution psi_exact(R,Z) = 0.5*(R^2 - R0^2)^2/(a^2) ... choose any smooth psi_exact for which Delta^* psi_exact can be computed analytically, set the finite-difference right-hand side from that analytic Delta^* psi_exact, impose psi = psi_exact as the Dirichlet boundary condition on all four edges, solve, and print the maximum-norm error ||psi_h - psi_exact||_inf. Take the domain R in [1.0, 3.0], Z in [-1.5, 1.5] with major-radius-like R0=2.0, use runtime options for the grid size via DMDA (-da_grid_x, -da_grid_y), print the grid spacing and the max-norm error, and also print PETSc's SNES convergence reason. Make the code clean, fully use PetscCall(), and be runnable both on 1 and multiple MPI ranks
